forbidden_signal_inputs: funding level, change, cadence, or rank
distinctness.not_s1z: Pairwise fixed-topology residual contrarian entry; never a cross-sectional residual-momentum cohort.

capacity_proxy.source: Each leg's prior complete UTC-day contract quote volume
capacity_proxy.strategy_capacity: Minimum leg capacity divided by its frozen gross-weight fraction

economics.execution_proxy: Signal on complete hourly close; enter or exit at the next hourly contract open.
economics.funding_cadence_custody: Treat each current row's funding_interval_hours as the elapsed cadence since the prior settlement; adjacent timestamps and leading/trailing segment coverage must match within 59999 ms, including after development/deferred merge.
economics.funding_proxy: Actual settled funding rate multiplied by entry quantity and the mark-price hourly open containing fundingTime; fundingTime may be 0 through 59999 ms after the hour and only events strictly inside the position are booked.

signal.entry: At complete hour t, use an OLS model estimated only on closes strictly before t; trade residual at close t at open t+1h.
signal.gross_weighting: A weight=1/(1+beta), B weight=beta/(1+beta), gross scaled to $1000
signal.maximum_one_position: One global $1000 pair position at a time per trial; choose greatest absolute eligible z, tie by frozen pair order.
signal.model_schedule: Refit alpha, beta, sigma, residual AR(1), and residual DF statistic once at 00:00 UTC from closes strictly before that timestamp; use that fixed model for the UTC day.
signal.position: Positive residual short A/long beta-weighted B; negative residual long A/short beta-weighted B. Entry alpha, beta, and sigma stay fixed for exit/stop tests and quantities; there is no rebalance.

bootstrap.method: Common-seeded circular seven-day block bootstrap over synchronous UTC days including zero days

statistics.drawdown: Maximum peak-to-trough loss in hourly marked stress equity using contract hourly opens, entry and exit costs at their event hours, and funding at settlement.
statistics.holm: One-sided centered block-bootstrap p-values, Holm-adjusted across all 12 trials
statistics.reality_check: Common-seeded centered maximum-mean block-bootstrap test across all 12 trials
